identity.one_liner: Considered, small-batch fashion in natural fibres for people who buy less but buy better.
identity.target_customer: 28-45 year old urban professionals who value craftsmanship and provenance over trend cycles; low purchase frequency, high average order value, researches before buying.
value_props: Made-to-last construction, not seasonal trend cycles

tone.voice_notes: Reads like a design journal, not an ad. Leads with craft and material story before price or promotion.

competitors.name: Nicobar
competitors.positioning_note: Closest direct competitor, similar handloom/considered-design ethos.

customers.summary: Skews premium and loyal-core: low discount-code usage, high AOV, low cart-abandonment, values exclusivity over price.

brand.semantic.competitors.name: Nicobar
brand.semantic.competitors.positioning_note: Closest direct competitor, similar handloom/considered-design ethos.

market_memory.patterns.pattern_statement: Adding explicit size/fit reassurance (try-on video, size-chart callout, fit guide) to the product page tends to reduce cart abandonment.
Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.

brief.buyer_power: Low, as the target segment is characterized by high loyalty, low discount usage, and a strong preference for craftsmanship and provenance over price.
brief.supplier_power: Moderate, as the brand controls the unique small-batch production process and traceable maker story, which provides differentiation against mass producers.
brief.competitive_rivalry: High among direct premium competitors (Nicobar, Bombay Shirt Company, Okhai), but rivalry is likely focused on narrative and quality rather than pure price competition due to the slow fashion positioning.
brief.threat_of_substitutes: Moderate. Substitutes exist in fast fashion or mass-produced alternatives, posing a threat if customers perceive the premium cost as too high relative to perceived value.
brief.threat_of_new_entrants: Moderate. Entry barriers are established by the requirement for specialized craftsmanship and building the necessary trust associated with a traceable, small-batch maker story.
brief.positioning_summary: Loom & Aster benefits from strong brand loyalty and premium pricing power. Margin defense relies on maintaining the perceived value of the unique traceability and slow fashion ethos to prevent commoditization by cheaper knockoffs.

constraints.product: Focus copy on the unique material composition, artisanal techniques, and inherent quality of the garment, positioning it as a lasting object rather than a trend.
constraints.price: Price must be presented as an investment reflecting true material cost and craftsmanship; promotional guidance must strictly avoid discount-led framing. Lead with the value of traceability and slow fashion ethos instead of price reduction.
constraints.place: Distribution should reflect exclusivity and curation, aligning with a high-end design journal aesthetic rather than mass retail urgency.
constraints.promotion: Absolutely no discount language, sale indicators, or urgency framing is permitted. Promotions must focus solely on the narrative of sourcing, maker stories, and the longevity of the craft.
constraints.people: Feature the makers, artisans, and sourcing partners prominently. The narrative should center on the human element behind the creation, emphasizing their expertise and process.
constraints.physical_evidence: Imagery must be editorial, calm, and highly aesthetic. Prioritize high-quality video content (UGC style) showcasing texture, drape, and the making process over static product shots.
constraints.process: The narrative must foreground the traceability and slow fashion ethos. Detail the journey of the materials and the careful, considered steps involved in production to reinforce margin defense against commoditization.
hard_rules: This line never goes on sale
Make the maker/sourcing story front and center
All copy must adopt an understated, calm, and considered tone, reading like a design journal.
Lead with the craft and material story before any mention of price or promotion.
